materialityRule.definition: Per year: flag if abs(scenario_fcf - reference_fcf) > 0.05 * abs(reference_fcf).
materialityRule.zero_reference_handling: If reference-year FCF is exactly zero, the percentage comparison is UNDEFINED (not zero, not 'no change') and must be reported as such; the absolute difference is reported separately regardless.
materialityRule.reporting_rule: The continuous absolute and (where defined) percentage difference is reported for every scenario-year alongside the boolean materiality flag -- the flag is a convenience marker, never a replacement for the underlying numbers.
materialityRule.status: 5% is an illustrative, predeclared convention for this protocol. It is not a proven or claimed threshold of economic significance.

R.name: R
R.rationale: Reference scenario. Illustrative, internally-coherent assumptions; anchor every other scenario is compared against.

O1.name: O1
O1.rationale: Isolated: higher revenue growth (10% -> 20%). All else identical to R.

O2.name: O2
O2.rationale: Isolated: lower revenue growth (10% -> 2%, toward flat but kept nonzero to keep the DCF-equivalence ratio construction well-defined -- see Sec. 8). All else identical to R.

O3.name: O3
O3.rationale: Isolated: higher operating margin (42% -> 55%). All else identical to R.

O4.name: O4
O4.rationale: Isolated: lower operating margin (42% -> 20%). All else identical to R. (v1 mischaracterized this as stressing the depreciation-vs-operating-expense diagnostic; a LOWER margin makes operating expense LARGER, not smaller, so it does not stress that diagnostic -- corrected here.)

O5.name: O5
O5.rationale: Isolated: higher capex intensity (15% -> 25% of revenue), depreciation held fixed (8%) -- isolates reinvestment intensity from book depreciation policy. All else identical to R.

O6.name: O6
O6.rationale: Isolated: higher supported working-capital drag (AR and inventory movement rule raised from 5% to 12% of the original opening balance). All else identical to R.

F1.name: F1
F1.rationale: Predeclared FINANCING PACKAGE (not a single-factor experiment): dividends and share repurchases both raised, funded partly by a larger long-term debt issuance in year 1. Operating/reinvestment assumptions identical to R.
predeclaredInvariants: unlevered_fcf[year] == R.unlevered_fcf[year] for all 3 years (financing-only package; must not change unlevered FCF)

F2.name: F2
F2.rationale: Predeclared FINANCING PACKAGE (not a single-factor experiment): minimum cash raised and revolver limit lowered together. Operating/reinvestment assumptions identical to R.
predeclaredInvariants: unlevered_fcf[year] == R.unlevered_fcf[year] for all 3 years (financing-only package; must not change unlevered FCF)

F3.name: F3
F3.rationale: Predeclared FINANCING PACKAGE, designed to refuse: minimum cash set far beyond plausible cash generation, revolver limit cut to a nominal amount. Operating/reinvestment assumptions identical to R, specifically so any refusal is attributable to the financing package alone, not to a simultaneous operating stress.
F3.expectedStatusDetail: Expected to refuse in year 1 with a funding-shortfall reason. Years 2-3 cannot be attempted if year 1 refuses (each year requires the prior year's completed LinkedPeriod) -- recorded as 'not attempted', not as a separate refusal.
predeclaredInvariants: If year 1 succeeds unexpectedly, that is a validation failure requiring stop-and-report per Sec. 7, not a reason to lower minimum_cash further.
